description: FKB-Veg is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Geovekst. FKB-Veg er en del av Felles Kartdatabase (FKB). FKB er en samling datasett som utgjør en sentral del av grunnkartet. Se metadataoppføring for Felles Kartdatabase for mer info. FKB-Veg inneholder detaljert informasjon om alle offentlige og private veganlegg. Spesifikasjonen gjelder for de enkelte vegelementene som beskriver veglegemets geometri. Coverage: Geovekst. The publisher named on the listing is Geovekst. Its keywords include Norge, Grunnkart, National, Nasjonalt, geodataloven, Veg. The listing shows 4 download or service links in TXT, GDB, XML, GML. The listing shows 2026-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.kartverket.no/geodataarbeid/norge-digitalt/partsinformasjon/avtaler-og-vilkar/norge-digitalt-lisens). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
